title: Arkansas hunting licenses, WMA permits, and fees
intro: A hunting license is required to hunt in Arkansas. Many WMAs require additional deer/turkey permits drawn through AGFC. Confirm current fees before you buy.

whereToBuy.title: Online
whereToBuy.body: Buy licenses and apply for WMA permits at https://www.agfc.com/licenses/.

whereToBuy.title: License agent
whereToBuy.body: AGFC license agents sell hunting licenses statewide.

whereToBuy.title: WMA permit draw
whereToBuy.body: WMA deer/turkey permit applications typically open June 1–July 1. Leftovers may be offered later.

whereToBuy.title: Over the counter
whereToBuy.body: Private-land deer seasons do not need a WMA permit; public land often does.

whereToBuy.title: Corps of Engineers lakes
whereToBuy.body: Corps project lands may allow public hunting under AGFC seasons with lake-specific restrictions.
